# Assets · Product UI

14 files under `assets/Product UI/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for interface-spending-permissions.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Real Payset product panels rendered on the stone ground (#706E67, token `stone`): spending rules, multi-signature approvals, member permissions, statements, transaction status, rating. Show them only in `ProductShowcase` on `surface-showcase` so the edges disappear. `interface-*` files are the panels on a raised tile; `phone-in-the-pocket-*` show the mobile app in context. `rules-3.png` is a white panel on transparent, for dark grounds.
